text:
jen: heads up 1 opened a tiny PR to fix the usage dashboard threshold wording + add a Go SDK snippet for setting quota headers. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/599

omar: nice. what's the wording change?

jen: replace 'tier cap' with 'rate cap' and clarify that quotas are enforced per-route then aggregated. also fixed a dead link to dashboards/panels/usage-rate.

li: can you add a short Go example? ops likes Go snippets.

jen: added this:
```go
client := redwood.NewClient(ctx, apiKey)
req := client.NewGenerateRequest("Hello")
req.Headers().Set("X-Redwood-Tier", "standard")
resp, _ := client.Generate(ctx, req)
```

omar: LGTM. nit: show how to read `tier_label` in analytics (metric name: `usage.tier_label`).

jen: done, and added note about dedicated commitments being excluded from metered tiers. also updated QA checklist to include verifying dashboard anchor ids after deploy.

docs-bot: reminder 1 docs PR #599 assigned to @omar for review. deadline 72h.

omar: will review today, thanks!
